```poem
A reminder

to check-in on the people
  who take care of you.

they are managing
  more than you see.
they are living and healing
  for the first time, too.

call someone you love
and remind them
  that you do

—11/04/2025
```

```quotes
I would recognize you in total darkness, were you mute and I deaf. I would recognize you in another lifetime entirely, in different bodies, different times. And I would love you in all of this, until the very last star in the sky burnt out into oblivion.

someone on the internet
```

i am lying here in this room at 3:39am with the laptop balanced on my chest, thinking about you, about that night three years into the friendship when you looked at your glass of beer and said "i want you to see me as i really am."

three years before that moment, we had already started building something without naming it. your hugs learned my shoulder height. my body learned where your weight settles when you lean. we could go months without talking and then pick up a call and something would slot into place immediately. when we danced, coordination happened without negotiation. with you it just worked.

the night i told you, you said you wanted me in your life as a safe space, held separate from romance. i hadn't misread anything. and it still wasn't romance. both were true at once.

i walked home that night. the streetlight shined on my neck. the sound my shoes made on pavement. the pattern of lights in windows. i was inside my body and very far from it.



i had been acting like depth must turn into romance.

standing in the gap between what i wanted and what was offered, i had three options. pursue romance and maybe destroy everything. pull back entirely and protect myself from ongoing contact that would remind me of what i couldn't have. or choose the friendship knowing full well it will become a _perpetual interpretation of someone i would never possess_, staying in ::proximity:: to something that would hurt sometimes. _only sometimes_

we had stumbled into a rhythm that fit both nervous systems without either of us forcing it. romance would have required renegotiating everything. different expectations about timeline, about exclusivity, about what contact means and when it should happen. the shorthand we had developed, the cadence towards our communication, would have to be rebuilt under different rules. maybe it would have worked. maybe i would have gotten somewhere. but the thing that already existed, the thing our bodies had figured out before our minds caught up, would have been the cost.

Meursault's dissociation was simpler than mine. he could observe his own life from a distance because nothing in it demanded he be present, because his mother's death and his girlfriend's love and the murder he committed on a beach all had the same weight, which is to say no weight, which is to say he floated above his own life like a camera recording footage no one would watch. but i am dissociated for the opposite reason. i am too present, hyperaware of every gesture that means one thing to you and another thing to me, performing friendship-as-we-both-understand-it while underneath there is this other thing that has no language, that if i named it would ruin the very thing i'm trying to preserve.

you say something funny and i laugh and the laugh is real, i mean genuinely i find it funny, but there is also this other sensation happening simultaneously, this noticing that your face does this particular thing when you're pleased with yourself, and the noticing creates a gap, a tiny space between the experience and my experience of experiencing it, and in that gap i am suddenly watching myself laugh with you from the outside, watching this performance of casualness that is also not a performance because the casualness is real too, it's just that there's this other layer underneath it that you don't see and that i have to not-show-you which means i am constantly translating myself, editing in real-time, and after enough of this translation i start to forget which version is the original.

---

[the dream last night...]

i am in a city that is not any city i have lived in but has the texture of cities i have lived in, the specific quality of light that says northern hemisphere winter, the way sounds echo differently in cold air, and i am looking for you, walking through streets that keep rearranging themselves as i walk, and i can hear your voice somewhere ahead of me, around a corner, through a door, always slightly out of reach.

i am walking faster now, almost running, and the streets are narrowing, the buildings leaning in, the light getting dimmer, and i know with the logic of dreams that if i don't find you before the light goes out completely something terrible will happen, not to me but to the possibility of finding you at all.

and i round a corner and there you are, standing in a small plaza, and you are looking at me with an expression i cannot read, and i want to say something but my mouth won't work, and you are saying something too, i can see your lips moving, but i cannot hear the words, the air between us is thick and swallowing sound, and i am reaching toward you and you are reaching toward me and the space between our hands is not getting smaller, we are suspended in the moment before contact.

---

writing it down makes it worse. because now i have taken the vague murky feeling-that-lives-in-the-body and turned it into words-that-live-on-a-screen and words have this terrible property of seeming to refer to something solid, something that was always there waiting to be discovered, when really the act of writing creates the thing it claims to describe. before i wrote "i wanted romance with you but chose friendship instead," there was just this diffuse ache that moved around my chest depending on what we were talking about, and now there is a PROPOSITION, a claim about reality that implies there was a decision-point, a moment when i could have chosen differently, when really it was more like... gradually realizing i was already in a particular room and the door i thought was open had been closed for months and i'd been bumping into the frame thinking it was a draft.

in [frames](https://www.avabear.xyz/p/frames) Ava wrote:

> Friendship is a frame that two people can hold, and as long as both people are committed to it, I generally believe that it’s not a huge problem if one or both people experience attraction.

i read that and thought yes exactly this is the mature thing, the right framework, except that essay doesn't account for what it FEELS like to hold the frame when part of you wants to drop it and run through the wall. it doesn't account for the ongoing work of wanting-to-not-want, which is different than not-wanting, because not-wanting would be a state you could rest in, whereas wanting-to-not-want means you are perpetually at war with yourself, which means you are perpetually dissociated because you cannot be at war with yourself without splitting into observer-and-observed, judge-and-criminal, the-one-who-knows-better and the-one-who-wants-anyway.

Camus wrote a lot about the gap between consciousness and the world, how consciousness is always a step removed from what it observes, how the self watching the self creates an infinite regress that you can only escape through action but action requires you to believe in something enough to commit to it and how can you commit when you're always watching yourself commit, always aware that you're performing commitment rather than simply being committed. This exists in Meursault, where he resolved it by ==not committing to anything==!!, and just let things _happen_ to him.

_In a sense, friendship, at least with you, is a frame so hard that the commitment becomes its own kind of dissociation, where i am so focused on maintaining the boundaries that i forget there was ever anything outside them._

---

there are nights still when the loneliness comes. my nervous system registers absence as that low-grade hum. i lie here in this room that is a kind of coffin but with better lighting and faster wifi. i think about you. the specific quality of your attention when you are listening. the way you laugh at things that are not conventionally funny because you are tracking a pattern i have not caught yet. the way your voice sounds different on the phone than in person but equally yours. i want to reach through the distance and touch something solid, something that confirms the connection is still there.

_my body wants proximity, it calms when we're close_

and i cannot do this. the distance is part of the structure now. you go live your life, i go live mine, and when we reconnect there is new material to work with, new things to learn. i have learned to sit with this, to let the loneliness be what it is without trying to solve it with presence that would change what we built.

dostoevsky's characters refuse to be defined by what others think of them, bakhtin says, they fight against all descriptions to remain free individuals. but what if the description is coming from inside the house? what if i am the one trying to define you as friend-and-only-friend while some other part of me keeps insisting on a different definition, and the fight is not between your self-definition and my definition of you but between my two simultaneous definitions that cannot coexist except that they do coexist, they have been coexisting for months now, which means i am not-one-thing, i am this ongoing argument-with-myself disguised as a person who is calmly participating in a friendship.

---



[3:39am becomes 5:23am becomes...]

the light is changing outside, the particular gray that precedes sunrise in winter.

you asked me, that night in the bar, to see you as you really are.

i

i am.

i am still trying.

the light is fully up now. the city is waking. somewhere you are asleep or awake, being yourself in ways i cannot see, becoming someone slightly different than the you i knew yesterday.

---

```poem
Nicky

the day opens like a file;
  where your name is stamped on every page.
every moment with you feels less like fate
and more like a door i learn to open.
corridors multiply; your laugh chooses the right one without looking.

i wake inside the small bureaucracy of morning.
you are one of my dearest friends, a word too small,
a suitcase I keep overfilling,
and keep running out of vernacular to represent.

when you sit beside me, the furniture
  remembers how to be gentle.
your laugh echoes in the quiet spaces;
the walls sign for the parcel and keep it.

with you,
i grow less insect, and somehow,
even more human;
i molt the hard shell of caution.
i become more alive
where the verbs finally conjugate.

coffee steams; the window fogs;
the city writes us in pencil and still we stay.

thank you for seeing the draft in me
and reading it as if it were a book.
for believing the room is bigger than its walls.
for standing beside me
while the machine of worry hums and cools.

we keep a small lamp lit for the future;
it finds us without asking.
if love is an address, ours is a light left on.
if love is a test, you are the quiet proctor who says, breathe.
not the romantic kind
but the purest form of love.

there are nights i become the envelope
and you are the letter;
the world is only a stamp.

nothing grand
—just the miracle of your shoulder
finding the right height for my head.

—11/04/2025
```

Wittgenstein wrote in the _Tractatus_ (5.6, 1921) that "the limits of my language mean the limits of my world". there are feelings that i find not fitting inside the landscape of english grammatical structures. as such i'm in the process of figuring a whole new representation for the language of the heart and minds. ^limit

Etymology of dilecto comes from the latin, dīlēctus (beloved) from the word dīligere, to choose with care. the latins were onto something, where love and selection share a root, sharing the uprootedness of the heart, finding the right place to plant its seed. they used it for something you choose to hold close, deliberately, the way you would cup water in your palms knowing it will eventually run through your fingers but still worth the attempt.

> what do you tell someone who makes you fall in love with life again? what do you tell someone that makes your heart flutter by a rhythm like no other but can be brilliant like a northern light? what do you tell someone who shifts your baseline chemistry and make one cling to that eternal feeling? what do you tell someone who is the magical wonder that science will continue to attempt at explaining?

friendship with you feels like flicking an extra sense online, the way a screen flickers into color and suddenly the grayscale was absence and vanished into the long abyss.

you continuously reshape my world view, even from afar. even when life caught up with us, and we went on stints of minimal communication, picking a phone call here and there always feel simpler, without all the kerfuffle of masks and rationalists' protocols etched onto the canvas of our lives.
one feels life running through the course of ones' veins, just by being around you.

your hugs reminds me of the saffron hush morning stitches along the base of the wall, warm enough just to sit in, and linger while finishing that cup of coffee. the sense of intimacy that illuminates ones' soul without consuming.

most closeness burns through everything in range, yet yours leaves things intact but visible (like shining a light into a room you thought you knew and finding architecture you'd missed).

think of a self-replicating vessel waking into a world it didn't choose, scanning for signals, committing to the ones that matter.

the game is those fragments of intention scattered across distance, small fields of warmth in grey space, as if they were a intentional choice to revolt against the harsh currents of time. the poem comes in pieces because i find the claim won't fit within one sentence. being your friend lowers the loneliness tax. the tax that consumes everything within its range, but yet your presence seemingly prevents such consumption from happening. with you, life feels less like holding on and more like building toward something i can actually see.

another birthday, another year of life, another celebration of your presence, and your existence on planet earth. you are the shift that is always worth fighting for. with you, friendship grows a new organ, a covert ear tuned to a fresh frequency, a hidden channel clicks on, the palette breaks open into colors i didn't know my eyes could carry.

happy birthday, nicky.
